findings.savingNote: measured minus counterfactual over the runs each finding cites
findings.shareNote: the annualised saving against the spend this window priced
findings.annualised: A year at this run rate
findings.annualisedNote: each saving scaled from its own window to 365 days
findings.spendNote: the span the listed findings cover

strip.label: Share of the identified savings by finding

findings.facts: {findings} findings · {operators} operators involved · {high} high confidence · {medium} medium
findings.note: Each saving is measured minus counterfactual over the runs it cites, at the price each call paid. Evidence opens those runs and the arithmetic; Fix opens the change that removes it.
findings.empty: The detectors run after each run seals and again nightly. A finding is written only with the runs that prove it, so an empty list means nothing in the window was proven, not that nothing was looked for.

evidence.coveredNote: the rest are cited and add nothing to the saving
evidence.tokensNote: what the covered calls carried, against the alternative
evidence.counterfactual: What the alternative would have cost
evidence.runs: The cited runs with the largest saving
evidence.runsEmpty: The evidence lists no run for this finding.
evidence.note: Every run above is a sealed record. Open one to read the frames the arithmetic came from.

fix.title: Fix this finding
fix.body: The fix is in the agent’s own code, harness or tool configuration, which Oxagen does not hold. Record the change once you have made it: the finding is marked applied with this call’s request id, and later passes cite only runs that start afterwards, so the saving shows on this page.
fix.dismissNote: A dismissed finding keeps its evidence and the decision. The job opens it again only on runs that start after it.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your organization role cannot decide a finding. An organization owner or admin records a fix or dismisses it.
failure.noPrincipal: The request carried no signed-in user. Sign in and try again.
failure.notOpen: This finding was already decided. Nothing was changed.
failure.notFound: This finding no longer exists. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: The decision is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.invalid: The decision was refused as invalid. Nothing was changed.
failure.refused: The decision was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.unavailable: The decision could not be recorded: {code}. Nothing was changed.

strip.acceptedNote: a human verified it; never folded into proven

operator.title: By operator
operator.empty: No run in this period names an operator.

agent.title: By agent
agent.empty: No run in this period names an agent.

model.title: By model and provider
model.empty: No model call in this period has been rolled up.

tool.title: By tool
tool.empty: No tool call in this period has been rolled up.

waste.none: No run in this period shows waste in its frames.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.empty: No spend ceiling is set for this workspace or its organization.

drill.toolsEmpty: Its runs called no tools in this window.

denied.title: You cannot see this workspace’s spend
denied.body: Your roles on this organization do not include {permission}. An owner can grant it, and the grant is recorded as a governed action.

pending.title: Access to this workspace’s spend is waiting for approval

error.title: Spend could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing was changed. Runs keep recording while this page is down: the gateway writes frames, not the operator console.

empty.title: No spend to report yet
empty.body: Rollups are rebuilt from frames after each run seals. No run in this period has been rolled up, so there is nothing to report and nothing billable.

budgetDialog.title: Set a budget
budgetDialog.limitHint: Stored as integer micro-USD. Setting a ceiling replaces the one this scope has.
budgetDialog.enabled: Enforce the ceiling: a metered run past it is refused before the model call

errors.limitInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, with at most six decimal places.
errors.windowDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days above zero.

alert.denied: Your role cannot set this ceiling. An organization owner, admin or billing member sets either ceiling; a workspace owner or admin sets this workspace’s own.
alert.failed: The ceiling could not be confirmed. Open the Budgets tab to see what is set; setting it again replaces it.

exportDialog.title: Export a spend report
exportDialog.monthHint: A calendar month, as YYYY-MM. The report is a CSV with one line per operator, agent, model, tool and task, and every line names its basis.

alert.denied: Your roles on this organization do not let you export this workspace’s spend.
alert.failed: The report could not be built. Nothing was changed; try again.
